backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining NFT collections, items, user profiles, and ICRC-7-style minting logic with role-based access control (admin/user) and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing two features: fixing the admin dashboard race condition between Internet Identity login and the admin-check query, and ensuring the backend actor always uses the authenticated identity.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key behaviors of each component, page, and hook in the React frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, sidebar, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light art portfolio app, setting German language, viewport meta, title, and mounting the React root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that configures TanStack Router with all routes (gallery, artwork, upload, blog, NFT gallery/detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider and Layout.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for creating or editing NFT collections, using create/update mutation hooks with validation, error display, and German-language toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of NFT collections with edit and delete actions, using a confirmation dialog for deletion and a modal dialog for editing via AdminCollectionForm.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing an NFT item, handling image upload with progress, collection selection, price input, and calling create/update mutation hooks on submit.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and edit/delete controls, using a confirmation dialog before deletion.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Displays a single legacy artwork as a card with an image, title, and description, with hover scale and overlay animations.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for a minted on-chain NFT showing image, token ID, mint date, owner principal, and optional 'Mein NFT' highlight badge for the current user.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main page layout wrapping children with a sticky header (logo, navigation, login button) and a footer crediting caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing a spinner during authentication and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top-level navigation bar component that renders route buttons for Home, NFT Gallery, Blog, Contact, and conditionally Upload and Admin links based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an NFT's image, title, collection name, price in ICP, and an optional link to the ICP explorer.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component that links to an NFT collection on an external marketplace, showing a cover image with loading/error states, title, description, and a 'buy and trade' label.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven NFT collection cards (Getgems/TON blockchain) with titles, descriptions, and preview images.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal that shows a full NFT's image, metadata (title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price), and copyable fields with an optional ICP explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture to educate users about the technology.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: React component that displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) and a link to the ICP Explorer, with helpers to format timestamps and ICP prices.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Reusable component that displays an ICP principal address (optionally shortened) with a tooltip showing the full value and a copy-to-clipboard button.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a StaticBlogPost interface and exports an array of static blog posts about light health topics (wavelengths, blue light effects, red light therapy).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, reinitializing it when the Internet Identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend actor's addCollection method and invalidates the nft-collections query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that creates an NFT via the backend actor, fetches the newly created item, and invalidates the nft-items query; includes auth error parsing.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes a collection by ID via the backend actor and invalidates both nft-collections and nft-items queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the backend actor and invalidates the nft-items query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old artwork backend which has been superseded by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array for backend blog posts, allowing static blog posts to still render.
Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, with loading state combining actor and query loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: Query hook that fetches all issued NFTs via the backend actor's listAllNFTs method.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches all NFT items from the backend actor's getAllNFTs method.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null, replacing the old artwork backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old category-based artwork backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null for a backend blog post, deferring to static posts.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend, only enabled when the user is logged in.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches the currently authenticated user's issued NFTs via the backend actor's listMyNFTs method.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, including login, logout, and identity state management via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks whether the currently authenticated caller is an admin by calling the backend actor's `isCallerAdmin` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Admin-check hook with a configurable timeout and retry logic, handling phases like waiting for the actor, checking admin status, and timing out for slow canister cold starts.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the backend actor and invalidates related query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile to the backend and invalidates the current user profile query on success.
Stub mutation hook for a contact form that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT collection's name and description via the backend actor and invalidates the collections query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook for artwork upload that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that handles image file validation, upload progress tracking, and uploading an image to the backend actor, returning an `ExternalBlob`.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a warm art-themed light and dark color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that gates access behind authentication and admin role checks, displaying NFT and collection management tabs with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: A placeholder page for artwork details that no longer functions since the old artwork backend was replaced by the NFT system. It simply displays a 'not found' message with a back button to the gallery.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Displays a list of blog posts by merging static light-health posts with backend posts, supporting navigation to individual posts. Admins see a button to create new posts.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only form page for creating new blog posts with a title, content, and optional featured image upload. Redirects non-admins back to the blog listing.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Renders a single blog post by ID, checking both static and backend sources. Displays the title, publication date, optional featured image, and full content.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that submits via the useSubmitContactForm hook. Shows success or error alerts and clears the form on successful submission.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Main gallery page showing a hero banner, a static quote, and NFT collections with loading skeletons and error handling. Renders NFTCollectionsSection and NFTExplanation components once data is loaded.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT showing its image, title, description, collection badge, price, and on-chain metadata. Includes a link to the Internet Computer dashboard and a back button to the gallery.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: React page that displays an NFT gallery with tabs for browsing all NFTs, issued NFTs, and the user's own NFTs, supporting collection filtering, minting via modal, and detail view. Requires Internet Identity authentication for minting and shows wallet/principal info.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: React page providing a form for authenticated users to upload and mint new NFTs by selecting an image, entering metadata, and choosing a collection. Handles image preview, upload progress, and posts the result via the useCreateNFT hook.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions for merging static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, finding a post by ID from either source, and formatting timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Async utility that copies a string to the clipboard using the modern Clipboard API with a textarea-based fallback for older browsers, returning a boolean success indicator.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display, truncating the middle with ellipsis based on configurable prefix/suffix lengths.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support for values like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom fonts (Inter, Playfair Display), OKLCH-based design tokens for colors, border radii, shadows, and keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the Istvan Seidel Portfolio app, recording two active fix features targeting a backend connection timeout race condition that blocks admin dashboard access via useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout and useActor.
